correctness.rationale: For each graph with n>=1, STAB is full-dimensional and downward closed. Exact centered containment is equivalent to q=(r+1)c in rP with q>=1, since 0 and every e_i belong to P and all vertex indicators are bounded by 1. Fractional-color LP yields r=chi_f. The antiblocker D is compact, strong LP duality identifies optimal y, and complementary slackness fixes q_i=1 on T. Finite D vertices with strict objective gap for all y_i>0 when i outside T give independent coordinate slack and affine dimension n-|T|. Perfect graphs have D=STAB(complement), proving the maximum-clique specialization. Fractional exact verifier checked six nontrivial graphs including C5 with 5/2. Universal result is a symbolic proof; no exhaustive graph search claimed.

value.rationale: The complete optimal-center classification and exact affine dimensions distinguish geometric rigidity of every graph stable-set polytope by supports of all dual optimum points; this refines the mere numeric asymmetry and is not an isolated recomputation. For C5 the invariant is noninteger 5/2 with unique center, whereas adding an isolated vertex to a clique yields a continuum of minimizers. Perfect graphs get a clean maximum-clique covering criterion and vertex-transitive graphs always have unique center. The structure is natural and full-family even though proof uses established LP duality; no general conjecture is required.
